_clip_note: A clip opens where the action starts: from the peak, walk back through the run of seconds where any onset signal is >= level (pauses up to gap_s allowed, at most lookback_s), then pre_roll_s more. Shorts retain best at 15-35 s and the first 2-3 s decide whether people stay, so the lead-in is short (pre_roll_s) and max is 35. Bounds snap to a shot change within scene_cut.snap_s. max is the longest a clip may become; the end is trimmed first. A clip never opens or closes on a menu/map/pause second.
_weights_note: A weight of 0 keeps a curve out of the score entirely (it still feeds the labels). vehicle, siren and crash start at 0 until the evaluation (tools/evaluate.py) shows they help.
_vision_note: SigLIP 2 pass (milestone M2): frames sampled per second of video and encoded on the GPU (DirectML), or at cpu_fps on machines without one. decode 'auto' uses NVDEC for the codecs listed (measured faster there) and the CPU otherwise; 'cpu' or 'nvdec' force one. The embeddings are cached; from M3 on they feed the moments.
_ocr_note: RapidOCR (PP-OCRv6) reads one frame every 1/fps seconds, skipping menus. Big centred text is matched whole-word against the lexicon (accents and case ignored) to find failures and achievements; subtitles mark the game's own dialogue. GTA 6 (pt-BR): 'wanted' marks where a police chase starts, 'escaped' where the police lose you. Subtitles are never matched.
_voice_note: Detected, never asked. Several audio tracks: the extra track with at least track_min_speech of speech is the microphone. One track: speech in a language other than game_language (GTA 6: English) is the player's; without language information, speech under a subtitle is the game's; if at least commentary_ratio of the speech (and commentary_min_s seconds) is not subtitled, the player is talking. With no player voice, the shout/laughter signal is scaled by no_voice_reaction (it is the game's).
_judge_note: AI review (offline, llama.cpp + Qwen3-VL-4B). One review per minutes_per_review of recording (between min and max), strongest candidates first; can be stopped early. weight: share of the final score from the AI's 0-10 (x10); the rest is the detectors' score. The clip may start earlier, where the AI says the action begins, minus pre_roll_s. frames: 16 pictures per clip, to place the start. rerank_top: the best N are then compared two by two (steadier than absolute scores). model: "4b" (default) or "8b"; on the 2-hour stream the 8B wrote more natural Portuguese but ranked the known best moments lower, copied a title example and needs +5.8 GB, so 4B stays.
_markers_note: Say "clipar agora" while playing: the clip ends just before the phrase and starts where the action did (up to lookback_s before; default_s when nothing stands out). It always survives overlaps and is always reviewed by the AI; min_score keeps it visible before the review.
_sound_groups_note: AudioSet class names exactly as in CED's class_labels_indices.csv. gunfire + explosion together are the 'action' curve.
_labels_note: Each rule maps a signal to [min_value, min_seconds]: sound groups by probability (>= present counts as present), see:<concept> by the relative vision curve. A moment gets the label whose best evidence clears its bar by the widest margin (>= 2 high, >= 1.4 medium, else low); a label carried by the picture alone is capped at low. Nothing qualifying = unlabelled. 'escape' (vehicle + siren followed by calm) stays off until reviewed data shows it is precise.
_visual_note: M3. concepts: SigLIP logit minus its rolling median, above `floor`, scaled by `span` (logit units). menu: (menu - ordinary) logit margin -> 0..1; the score is multiplied by (1 - suppress * menu) and a moment whose peak is that sure of being a menu is dropped. present_floor: a concept must also reach this absolute logit (SigLIP's own scale) to count. motion: optical flow on the `top` moments only; the median residual (local) motion, minus `floor` px/frame at 320 px width, over `span`. dedupe: same-label moments that look alike (cosine of their mean frames) or nearly touch are merged.
